BiblicalUsage: God puts on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon His head, and puts on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and is clad with zeal as a cloak. The word is a garment, clothing: the dress of a warrior going out to save His people. It appears once, in the arming of the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the garment is the promise: when no man intercedes, God puts on His own armour, and the clothing of vengeance is worn by the One who saves.
